metadata.title: Crap From The Past - August 10, 2007: A detailed, thorough, comprehensive look at the entire chart career of Yarbrough And Peoples
metadata.description: A pop music radio show for people who already know plenty about pop music, hosted by Ron "Boogiemonster" Gerber and heard every Friday night from 10:30 to midnight on KFAI-FM, 90.3 FM Minneapolis, 106.7 FM St. Paul, and KFAI.org.
metadata.notes: Other 2007 shows Still in mono. I'll be taking a look at the antenna in my house to try and improve the reception, but unless a miracle happens, these archive will likely remain in mono until KFAI goes "HD" in the fall. HE'S MISSTRA KNOW IT ALL - Stevie Wonder (1977) I GO TO RIO - Peter Allen (1976) LITTLE BIRD - Annie Lennox (1993) EVERY DAY I DIE - Frantic Elevators (featuring a pre-Simply Red Mick Hucknall!) GIRL YOU NEED A CHANGE OF MIND - Charles Earland (1973) I HAVE THE SKILL - Sherbs (1981) CIRCLES - Atlantic Starr (1982) CLEVELAND ROCKS - Ian Hunter (1979) **Look What I Found!** I FEEL LOVE - Enoch Light and many of the world's finest musicians (1977) I WANT YOU - Shana (1989) THE RIDDLE (12") - Nik Kershaw (1984) VIDEO! - Jeff Lynne (1984) DOIN' THAT CRAZY THING - Jeff Lynne (1977) DON'T STOP THE MUSIC - Yarbrough and Peoples (1981) DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME - Yarbrough and Peoples (1985) DIG THAT BEAT - The Bangs (1981) BABY MAKES HER BLUE JEANS TALK - Dr. Hook (1982) THE MAIN EVENT/FIGHT - Barbra Streisand (1979)
